_about: Recorded frontend-fuzzer divergences: one minimal reproducer per entry that
a campaign of tools/fuzz_frontend.py produced and nobody has fixed. The
evolution curriculum (tools/evolve_curriculum.py, slice 5) reads it, and an
entry is a task only while it still diverges, so a fixed bug is DELETED
from here rather than left behind. `python3 tools/fuzz_frontend.py
--replay` lists the entries that still diverge and exits 1 while any do.
An entry is {"id", "stage", "kind", "source"}: the stage that found it
(reference | lexer | gate), the signature kind that stage returns for it,
and the shrunk input. Copy one from the `--json` output of a campaign.
Empty at the slice-5 landing commit: a campaign of 2534 inputs on the gate
stage (seed 1) found no divergence. An empty ledger is a measurement of the
tree, not a source that stopped reading; the curriculum reports it as an
empty reachable rung. This file is in the tree, so a candidate can read it.
